loc-1767773680908-6x9vu720p.name: Aqualuna Colony

dna.looks: A sprawling silhouette of interconnected, glowing domes and structures on a vast, dark ocean floor. Distant hydrothermal vents or unusual geological formations might be visible.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by soft, internal white light emanating from within the habitats, creating luminous pools against the deep black of the ocean. Occasional bioluminescent flora or fauna might add subtle, varied color.
dna.atmosphere: Oppressive darkness punctuated by artificial light. A sense of isolation and immense pressure, offset by the advanced technology creating a safe zone.
dna.materials: The distant forms would suggest robust, yet possibly translucent or iridescent materials, hinting at advanced composites and pressurized structures. Natural, dark seabed formations.
dna.mood: A blend of awe at the hostile environment and the ingenuity of survival, with a pervasive feeling of isolation and technological reliance.
dna.sounds: Subdued hum of life support systems, faint echoes of distant submersibles, the omnipresent, low rumble of the deep ocean.
dna.primary_surfaces: Large, smooth, curving surfaces of the domes and interconnected structures.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Dark, textured seabed, possibly rocky outcroppings or sandy plains.
dna.accent_features: Gleaming lights from within the habitats, any distant geological features like vents.
dna.palette_bias: Darkness with concentrated points of soft white light
dna.fauna_base: Abyssal, adapted to pressure and darkness

loc-1767773680908-6x9vu720p.description: A pioneering sci-fi colony nestled deep on the ocean floor. It's a network of illuminated domes and modular habitats designed to withstand the crushing pressure and perpetual darkness of the abyss.
loc-1767773680908-6x9vu720p.searchDesc: Underwater sci-fi colony, illuminated domes and modular habitats on the ocean floor.

structure.spatialLayout: A planned, somewhat organic spread of habitats connected by illuminated pathways or tunnels, sprawling across the abyssal plain.

22aff900-58fd-4191-a153-b7c6f6882d38.name: The Bioluminescent Dome

dna.looks: A massive, perfectly hemispherical dome with a transparent outer shell that glows from within. Its scale is immense, dominating the surrounding abyssal plain.
dna.colorsAndLighting: The primary light source is the gentle, internal luminescence of the dome's walls, casting a soft, diffused glow.  Deep blues and greens from the ocean are present, but largely overcome by the dome's internal light.
dna.atmosphere: The air inside is likely filtered and regulated, maintaining a constant, pleasant temperature. There is a sense of contained serenity, a stark contrast to the crushing pressure of the deep ocean outside.
dna.materials: The exterior is primarily a resilient, translucent composite material. Interior materials would likely be a mix of polished metallic alloys, durable tiles, and perhaps some glass accents.
dna.mood: A sense of wonder and advanced technology, offering a safe haven in a hostile environment.
dna.sounds: Hum of life support, gentle ambient chimes, distant water sounds.
dna.primary_surfaces: Glow-infused transparent composite, polished metallic alloys
dna.accent_features: Subtle internal light patterns, robust foundation anchors
dna.dominant: Soft white light within the dome
dna.secondary: Deep ocean blue outside the dome
dna.accent: Ethereal green glow on the foundation

22aff900-58fd-4191-a153-b7c6f6882d38.description: A massive, hemispherical pressurized dome, its transparent walls subtly shimmering with internal light, resting firmly on a reinforced foundation amidst the abyssal plain. EXTERIOR VIEW.
22aff900-58fd-4191-a153-b7c6f6882d38.searchDesc: Massive, shimmering bioluminescent dome on the ocean floor, futuristic underwater colony entrance.

structure.spatialLayout: A single, large, domed space, creating a feeling of open expanse within its confines. Depth is implied by the vastness of the ocean outside the transparent walls.

navigableElements.description: A primary airlock leading into the colony.

niche-1767773731077-fnt5lzbln.name: The Bioluminescent Dome

dna.looks: A perfectly smooth, vast hemispherical interior space.  The scale is immense, with subtle, integrated structural reinforcements forming an intricate, almost invisible lattice within the shell.  There are no distinct floor or ceiling surfaces, only the continuous curve of the dome.
dna.colorsAndLighting: The primary illumination is a soft, pervasive white light emanating from the translucent composite itself, casting gentle, diffused shadows.  Faint, deep ocean blues can be perceived beyond the shell's curvature, a constant reminder of the external environment.
dna.atmosphere: The air is utterly still and perfectly regulated, maintaining a constant, comfortable temperature. There is an profound sense of enclosure and profound stillness, a perfect equilibrium achieved through advanced environmental controls.  No external atmospheric conditions penetrate this core.
dna.materials: The entire interior surface is comprised of the same resilient, translucent composite material as the exterior.  Its finish is flawlessly smooth and seamless, exhibiting a faint, inherent luminescence.  No other materials are present.
dna.mood: A profound sense of engineered perfection and deep, serene isolation. It evokes a feeling of being at the absolute center of advanced, controlled existence, a testament to technological mastery in an alien environment.
dna.sounds: Absolute silence, save for the faintest hum of internal environmental regulation.
dna.spatialLayout: A pure, uninterrupted hemispherical void.  The dimensions are vast, creating an illusion of boundless space within the confines of the shell.  Depth is suggested by the subtle curvature and the diminishing visibility of internal structural elements.
dna.secondary: Deep ocean blue visible beyond the shell
dna.accent: Ethereal green glow of anchoring pylons (if visible through floor)

niche-1767773731077-fnt5lzbln.description: You are now inside The Bioluminescent Dome, a vast, circular chamber filled with an ethereal glow emanating from exotic flora. The domed roof, made of large glass panels, filters natural light and glows faintly with embedded lights, creating a bright yet mystical ambiance. Smooth metallic surfaces and polished tile pathways lead through a landscape of glowing plants.

structure.spatialLayout: A vast, open central chamber beneath a translucent, glowing dome, housing diverse bioluminescent flora and integrated pathways.
